description: Issue #147: the two ecosystems the ADR's table does not name but FILE_EXT accepts. Ruby gets RSpec's `_spec.rb`. The JVM gets `<Base>Test.<ext>` twice: Maven and Gradle mirror `src/main/<lang>/…` into `src/test/<lang>/…`, which is as mechanical as Go's rule, so the mirrored path is emitted whenever the declared path actually carries a `src/main/` segment — and the sibling is emitted too for the single-module and Android-style trees that do not use that layout. Deriving only the sibling would leave every standard Maven repository with the failure this exists to remove.
